description:
Download Abyves - Abyssal Vestiges v1.0.6

This mod uses pictures made by AI but edited by myself for portraits and market illustrations.

Requires LazyLib and MagicLib

Requires a new save to be used and cannot be removed from a save.

Features
Adds 3 new [REDACTED] ships and 1 fighter - They can be used by the player and one of them has modules
Adds a system in the Abyss with a jump-point, a gate and a station
Adds a bounty using MagicLib - It also has modules and is the last one on the picture
Adds a Nexerelin custom start and background if Nexerelin is installed

WARNING - THREAT DETECTED
Spoiler
The ships in this mod follow THREAT ship doctrine. They run on very little fuel but their shields are terrible. They do not have built in fragment swarms and their hullmod 'Threat Hull' is a weaker version of the vanilla 'Threat Hull'.
This mod adds a THREAT station. Since it's not changing any THREAT values for mod compatibility, you can buy regular THREAT ships at that station. I advise against doing so, as the vanilla Overseer ship system crashes the game when the player flies the ship.

[REDACTED]
Spoiler

Compatibility
Should be compatible with most mods, as it makes a new system and changes nothing of the THREAT faction. The mod just adds new ships.
Any mod changing the Galatia Academy or removing it outright will not be compatible, as the one quest of this mod requires the player to go there.

Changelog
Spoiler
14th of August - Release v1.0.6
- Set Eos system as HIDDEN

3rd of August - Release v1.0.5
- Changed hullmod distribution
- Changed descriptions to be shorter
- Changed Facilitation Unit variant to fit the other ships
- Balancing tweaks

3rd of August - Release v1.0.4
- Fixed Fortress Unit sprite
- Changed variants to not include Voltaic Discharge (needs Fragment Swarm hullmod), except for start ship as intended downside

2nd of August - Release v1.0.3
- Fixed intro quest not ending

2nd of August - Release v1.0.2
- Fixed the starting dialogue removed in v1.0.1

2nd of August - Release v1.0.1
- Fixed starting position of custom start not working with mod factions
- Fixed sprite of bounty ship
- Adjusted ship system of bounty ship

1st of August - Release v1.0
Initial release

Credits
LazyWizard for LazyLib
Tartiflette & Wispborne for MagicLib
Histidine for Nexerelin
ruddygreat, rolfos and toopok4k3 for helping with the hullmod code and the rules.csv
